feature: Bulk notice search by XLSX upload (staff portal)
story: Tidak jelas (sibling di epic 6, belum dicek)
note: Staff bisa upload file XLSX berisi daftar nomor notice/kendaraan lalu melihat hasilnya dalam datagrid. OCMS6.2 sampai 6.5 tidak menyebut upload; mungkin tercakup story lain di epic 6 atau di epic lain. Hanya nama file dan route yang saya baca, isi logikanya belum. Tiket OCMS-DF-2026-187 (Pending UAT) menyangkut sort di layar hasil bulk ini.
note_en: Staff can upload an XLSX file with a list of notice/vehicle numbers and see the result in a datagrid. OCMS6.2 to 6.5 do not mention upload; it may be covered by another story in epic 6 or elsewhere. I only read file names and the route, not the logic. Ticket OCMS-DF-2026-187 (Pending UAT) concerns sorting on this bulk result screen.

feature: Batch operations from the search result (Apply Operation dropdown, for example bulk TS/PS)
story: Tidak jelas (kemungkinan story suspension/operation di epic lain)
note: Dari daftar hasil pencarian, staff bisa memilih notice lalu menjalankan operasi massal lewat dropdown Apply Operation. Story 6.2 sampai 6.5 hanya bicara query dan tampilan, jadi fitur ini di luar story yang saya terima. Logikanya belum saya telusuri.
note_en: From the search result list, staff can select notices and run a bulk operation through the Apply Operation dropdown. Stories 6.2 to 6.5 only cover query and display, so this feature is outside the stories I was given. I did not trace its logic.

feature: REP CCS violation image/video link (open media on the REP CCS server)
story: Tidak jelas (kemungkinan story REPCCS di epic 1)
note: Endpoint repccs-violation-media-link menukar ImageID/VideoID di notice dengan URL media di REP CCS. Saya memakainya sebagai bukti parsial di OCMS6.1 (video notice REPCCS), tetapi story 6.1 tidak menyebut REP CCS, jadi fitur ini tetap saya catat sebagai kode tanpa story. Header kode menyebut OCMS-DEV-2026-069.
note_en: The repccs-violation-media-link endpoint exchanges the ImageID/VideoID on a notice for media URLs on REP CCS. I used it as partial evidence in OCMS6.1 (REPCCS notice video), but story 6.1 does not mention REP CCS, so I still log it as code without a story. The code header cites OCMS-DEV-2026-069.

feature: CES attachment download cron with decode gate, MD5-verified upload and self-heal of corrupt blobs
story: Tidak jelas (kemungkinan story CES di epic 1/2)
note: Cron harian 07:00 mengambil zip foto dari SFTP, memverifikasi bahwa gambar bisa di-decode, upload ke Azure Blob dengan Content-MD5, memperbaiki blob rusak, dan menahan zip di SFTP bila gagal (OCMS-SR-2026-056). Saya memakainya sebagai bukti ingest foto di OCMS6.1, tetapi story 6.1 hanya bicara view/download, jadi ingest dan self-heal-nya sendiri saya catat sebagai kode tanpa story.
note_en: A daily 07:00 cron takes photo zips from SFTP, verifies the images decode, uploads to Azure Blob with Content-MD5, repairs corrupt blobs, and keeps the zip on SFTP on failure (OCMS-SR-2026-056). I used it as photo-ingest evidence in OCMS6.1, but story 6.1 only covers view/download, so the ingest and self-heal themselves are logged as code without a story.
